posts.caption: I had no idea this place existed 🙈 but is it any good?   💾 SAVE THIS and send it to someone who loves a pre-flight pint with a view!   🍺 SO WHERE IS IT?   📍The Camden   I’ve actually walked past this pub loads of times and knew it was there, but I had no idea they had an upstairs viewing area - and after seeing how busy Spoons was, I was hopeful that this was going to be a quieter alternative.   👀 AND WAS IT?   Well… It was busy downstairs, but the upstairs area with the runway views was actually a lot quieter and we even managed to get a table. I honestly think many people don’t realise that the upstairs has runway views! 🍺 WAS IT MORE PRICEY?   This is the downside… yes it was! For example, an ‘original cheese and burger with chips’ in Spoons is £16.45 And in The Camden, it’s £18.49 That can really add up if you’re eating and drinking before your flight!   📣 LET ME KNOW...   Did you know this place existed in Stansted? And do you always have a drink before your flight?? #stanstedairport

posts.caption: 🚨 STANSTED LOUNGE UPDATE 🚨 You may have spotted that Escape Lounge at Stansted Airport has closed 😭 So here’s your options now ⬇️ 🛋️ There’s a NEW lounge called ‘Essence by Escape Lounges’ near Gates 1-19 but there’s a snag…   It’s not available for passengers flying with Ryanair, AJet or easyJet because it’s in a different part of the airport. So I don’t recommend booking that if you’re flying with them and instead spending your money in the general area of the airport. Did anyone day Wetherspoons?? 💳 However if you usually get free access with Priority Pass, there is another option…  You can head to: 📍 The Camden Where you’ll get £18 to spend on food and drink - but bear in mind it needs to be in one single transaction (so don’t go just ordering 1 pint!). You’ll also need your Priority Pass QR code so make sure you’ve signed in on the app, or have your card saved to your wallet as the card alone may not work. And look, it’s better than nothing but the downside is that my meal and Guinness cost over £18, meaning I had to pay out of my own pocket. 📆 Will there ever be a lounge again?! The good news is that Stansted is planning a new airport lounge as part of its £1.1 billion transformation project!  In fact, it’s spending £600 million expanding its existing terminal, creating a bigger departures area with more shops, restaurants, seating and a new lounge.  HOWEVER - there’s no confirmed opening date for the new lounge yet 😭 📣 So LET ME KNOW For those who love the lounge, where have you been heading instead? And has it made you miss the lounge, or realise it’s just as good outside of it?!! #sta#stanstedairporta#stanstedairportloungecapelounge

a Kia around the figure of 8 track for a timed lap just like I was on top gear was absolutely incredible. In the end we came second which isn't too bad. The instructors were amazing, the cars were fantastic and the entire day was action packed. If you wanted to have one of the best days ever then this exact event is being hosted again on December the 3rd. Check out Everyman Driving Experiences to learn more.
